about: Stage 3 clip picks for scene D (2026-10-21/22 autonomous run). Frame id -> chosen file (relative to media unless a full path is given), in/out seconds inside that file, and what the stage 4 assembly needs to know. Every take, prompt and credit is in shots.md; the spend is in scripts/gpom/second-half-video/ending/ledger.json (scene 'D').
engine: Omni 1.1 Flash, Frames (start frame only), 16:9, 720p, x1; 1280x720 24 fps; clips carry Omni's own audio (mute on the timeline)
